headline: 🔥 DO: GET YOUR SELLERS ON THE PHONE ABOUT THE 1709 FIELDSTONE OFFER — the first offer this listing has ever taken landed at 3:15 this afternoon at full list with a five percent concession behind it, you already sent them your recommended counter at 4:54, and nothing moves until they say yes · ✅ ALSO SETTLED TODAY: the 5167 Lake Crest closing date conflict is resolved — the re-issued closer invite reads Aug 20 and all five parties are on it · WATCH: that Aug 20 still has no executed amendment behind it.

notes: 🔥 THE BIGGEST THING THAT HAS HAPPENED ALL WEEK HAPPENED AT 3:15 THIS AFTERNOON. 1709 Fieldstone took its first offer in fourteen days on market — from the exact agent who called Monday night to ask whether he was bidding against anyone, which is the question that always comes before a contract. Full list price on the front, a five percent seller concession on the back. You had your read and your recommended counter to the sellers inside ninety-nine minutes. It is now entirely a seller decision.

✅ THE 5167 LAKE CREST DATE CONFLICT IS OVER. The board carried '8/14 or 8/20, unresolved' all day; the re-issued closing invite landed at 1:55 this afternoon and reads Thursday Aug 20 at 3:00 at the law firm — exactly the date the closer asked for and your seller approved on Monday. All five parties are on the same date now. ⚠️ WHAT DID NOT CHANGE: there is still no executed amendment on paper. The date is agreed and unpapered, which is a documentation risk, not a money one.

🔑 NINTH RUN BLOCKED BY ONE SIGN-IN — NINE COMMITS NOW STRANDED. All three boards rebuilt and committed again this evening; none can publish. The GitHub CLI has been signed out since Monday's migration and re-checked this run: not logged in to any host. What your phone shows is still Tuesday morning. `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, and everything ships on the next pass. ⏸️ Separately: zero ShowingTime events in thirty-four hours, so nothing is owed and nothing was missed.

callBlock.why: 🔥 THE ONLY CALL ON THIS BOARD THAT DECIDES A CONTRACT TONIGHT. Their house took its first offer at 3:15 and your recommended counter went to them at 4:54. ⭐ Nothing on this file moves until they say yes or no — and offers that sit overnight are how a motivated buyer starts re-reading the other houses on his list.

STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ANYWHERE ELSE ON YOUR BOARD, and it is now five days old. Her buyer wants to write on the Altamont unit and is short on down payment, nothing else. ⭐ THE PHONE IS THE ONLY DOOR: with agent outreach suspended by your own Monday ruling, no machine will ever send this one for you.

THE FIRST REPLY THE RECONNECT LANE HAS EVER PRODUCED, and it came back in 82 minutes this morning. A past client who wants something inexpensive on Lay or Logan Martin — a double-wide would do. ⭐ A live buyer who raised his own hand. Call him tonight while the email is still the reason.

🔴 STILL THE WORST NUMBER ON THIS LIST: ZERO TOUCHES, EVER. Third buyer off your 1709 Fieldstone ad, re-engaged himself on a Sunday afternoon, and nothing has ever gone out to him in any channel. Now four days overdue — on the listing that just took an offer.

⚠️ A PROMISE MADE IN YOUR NAME IS NOW TWO DAYS PAST DUE. Brand-new buyer off the 1709 Fieldstone ad, and the email that went out under your signature told him you would call him that day. That is the one kind of overdue that costs you the lead outright.

⭐ THE ONLY NAME HERE WITH PAPER BEHIND IT — you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on this seller, and the listing consult you booked never happened. This is not a lead to qualify; it is a commitment already made on both sides that nobody has finished.

🆕 SHE WAS BACK ON YOUR SITE 38 MINUTES AFTER YOUR 2:58 PRE-LIST EMAIL LANDED — that is a seller reading her own plan. ⭐ The tenant answer is now fourteen days owed and the condo scope email you promised is still out. She has stopped asking, which is worse than asking.

New buyer off the Fieldstone ad whose email HARD BOUNCED — nothing you or any machine sends will ever land. ⚠️ If she does not get a call she gets nothing at all, and that has been true for four days.

listings.status: 🔥 OFFER RECEIVED $380K list — the first offer in fourteen days on market, landed 3:15 PM, your counter is with the sellers
listings.note: 🔥 THIS IS NOW THE ONE THING ON THE BOARD. The offer came from the agent who called Monday night to ask whether he was bidding against anyone — that question is almost always the last step before a contract, and here it was. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF IT MATTERS MORE THAN THE HEADLINE NUMBER: it is written at full list on the front with a five percent seller concession on the back, so the real number to your sellers is meaningfully below the sticker. There is also a co-op commission written above what the listing publishes, and a very short inspection period. ⭐ YOU MOVED FAST AND WELL: you pre-empted the commission gap with the buyer's agent by text within eleven minutes, he acknowledged it, and your recommended counter — a higher price and a later closing date — was in front of your sellers by 4:54. ⏰ THE CLOSING DATE IS THE STRATEGIC CORE, NOT THE PRICE: you deliberately asked for a date longer than the buyers wanted because your sellers' new build lands inside that window. ⚠️ NOTHING IS APPROVED YET. Your counter is a recommendation, not an authorization, and no routine may treat it as accepted. ⚠️ The net figures on both sides carry an unconfirmed HOA proration — neither net is final. ⭐ This listing was also, separately, your best lead source all week: four of the names on today's call block came off this one ad, and one of them has still never been touched.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — THE DATE CONFLICT IS RESOLVED: closing is Thursday Aug 20, all five parties agree
listings.note: ✅ THE ITEM THIS BOARD CARRIED AS TODAY'S WATCH IS HALF RETIRED. The re-issued closing invite landed at 1:55 this afternoon and the calendar now reads Thursday Aug 20, 3:00 PM at the law firm — the exact date the closer asked for and your seller approved on Monday. The board can stop saying 'the close date exists only in conversation.' ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL OPEN, AND IT IS NOW THE WHOLE ITEM: there is no executed amendment on either date. Everyone agrees in writing across three channels and nothing is signed. ⭐ Both dates land in August so the forecast does not move — this is documentation risk, and one signed extension retires it entirely. ⭐ The deal itself is clean: inspections done including septic, appraisal complete and clean. Next thing to watch for is clear-to-close from the lender or the closing attorney.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $351K contract price — repair addendum landed 7:31 AM, your response went back at 3:44 PM
listings.note: ✅ A FULL LOOP CLOSED INSIDE ONE DAY. The repair addendum arrived at 7:31 this morning after a week of waiting, and your response was back across the table by 3:44 this afternoon. ⭐ THE EARLY-POSSESSION ASK GOT A SOFT YES: the buyer's agent accepted it at 2:47. ⚠️ THE OLDER PAPER IS STILL UNSIGNED: the address-correction addendum has now sat on dotloop for three days with no signature receipt, on a file where the closing agent already holds the earnest money. It is housekeeping — which is exactly why it keeps getting skipped. ⚠️ The buyers' own home-sale contingency has still never been receipted, seven days on. ⭐ Note for the seller conversation: contract price is $351,000, not the $369,000 list — every repair dollar comes off a net that already carries $8,000 in closing costs and a warranty.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — the counter ask is now three days old and the agreement dies Aug 14
listings.note: 🔴 THIS SLID BEHIND FIELDSTONE TODAY, AND THAT IS THE RIGHT CALL — but the clock did not slide with it. The buyer's agent asked for a counter number out loud, twice, and named his buyer's own ceiling while doing it. That is a buyer negotiating against himself, which only happens while he thinks somebody is listening. ⏰ THE DEADLINE IS UNCHANGED AND CLOSING: your listing agreement expires 2026-08-14 — EIGHT DAYS — while the counter under discussion proposes an Aug 31 contingency deadline, seventeen days past your authority to represent these sellers. ⚠️ Nothing outbound to either party appears in email or the text relay today; stated as ABSENCE, not failure, since a phone call leaves no trace in any lane this board reads. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCE IS STILL THE PROBLEM: you cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first — and it is the same call that gets the agreement extended.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — the 11:00 tour ran this morning and no read has come back six hours later
listings.note: ⏳ THE VERDICT ON THE PRICE CUT IS STILL PENDING, AND IT IS NOW LATE ENOUGH TO CHASE. The first fresh booking this listing took since three separate buyers said the number was wrong went through at 11:00 this morning. Six hours on, no written read — most forms land the same evening, so this is the hour it goes from normal to worth a phone call. ⭐ It is the single most informative read you will get this week: it decides whether the $299,000 → $295,000 cut bought real traffic or one curious agent. ⛔ Nobody has ever named a replacement number: every price-recommendation field on all three prior reads came back blank. Quote $295,000 only.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $164K — a named buyer wants to write, and the decision is still yours to make
listings.note: 🔥 The only unqualified YES left on the board, now five days old. ⚠️ THE OPEN QUESTION IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS A DECISION, NOT A TASK: authorize a concession and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⚠️ HONEST NOTE — you have still not asked your seller for a number, which is why this is deliberately not being pushed as tonight's headline decision: a decision with nothing behind it is theater. The unblocker is one question to your seller, and you are likely to have him on the phone about Lake Crest anyway. ⏰ This file has also read AGREEMENT EXPIRING since 7/22 with no date ever pulled from the notice — fifteen days of an unread clock.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $559K — too high on the first read since the contract died, with an EIFS question behind it
listings.note: ⚠️ THE FIRST TOUR AFTER A RE-LIST IS THE READ A PROPERTY GETS GRADED ON, and this one came back too high with the worst staging score on file. The two reads before the contract both said JUST RIGHT, so the shift is real and recent. 🔴 A HARDER QUESTION SURFACED TUESDAY: there is no bond on the EIFS here. On synthetic stucco a buyer's inspector finds that independently, and it is a plausible part of why a contract already died once. ✅ RESOLVED TODAY: this was the one active transaction named on a teammate's licence-compliance notice — you answered it at 8:38 this morning and both halves are done. That risk is off this file. ⭐ THE STAGING 2 IS FIXABLE TODAY AND COSTS NOTHING. Fix that before anyone touches price.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $189K — the approved cut is now fourteen days old and still unverified
listings.note: 🔴 THE RISK IS TWO PUBLIC PRICES, NOT A SLOW SALE. A cut was approved two weeks ago with no receipt anywhere that it took effect in the MLS — on a listing whose only written read said the price was too high, and which has now gone twenty-five days without a showing. ✅ Two minutes to pull the MLS line and close it. ⚠️ That single written read falls out of the fourteen-day window tomorrow, which will leave this file with no feedback history at all. ⭐ Same seller as Altamont and Lake Crest — three files, one phone call.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $364K — a read validated your price eight days ago and the seller still has not been told
listings.note: 🔴 DAY EIGHT OF A SELLER NOT HEARING GOOD NEWS. A price called JUST RIGHT by someone with no reason to flatter it, overall rating 4 of 5, is exactly what an out-of-state condo seller wants to hear. ⚠️ A validated price with no buyer is a marketing conversation — and you cannot have it with someone who does not know the price was validated.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — she read your pre-list plan today and the tenant answer is still fourteen days owed
listings.note: 🆕 SHE WAS BACK ON THE SITE 38 MINUTES AFTER YOUR 2:58 PRE-LIST EMAIL — that is a seller reading her own plan and thinking about it. ⭐ That is the warmest this file has been in two weeks, and it is the moment to call rather than wait. 🔴 A CLIENT WHO HAS TO CHASE TWICE ON SOMETHING ORDINARY STARTS ASSUMING THE HARDER QUESTIONS WILL GO THE SAME WAY. Sixty seconds, whether or not you have the answer. ✅ The ceiling-height video she asked for went out last night, so the reason to call is concrete rather than apologetic. ⚠️ The condo scope email you promised 'shortly' is still owed.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — Sunday's open house is six days back and nothing has captured what happened at it
listings.note: ⚠️ YOUR MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING, SELLERS LIVING IN IT, and the only event it has had in a week exists only in your head — six days on, which is past the point where detail survives. Five minutes of dictation makes it usable. ⭐ THE LAND COMPONENT IS PINNED NOW: the parcel runs 40 acres, and the one written objection this file has ever taken was about the land, not the price. ✅ A seller-side question on this address was solved into a call chip yesterday morning.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the largest number on your board, and your written position still has not gone across
listings.note: 🔴 FIVE ASKS AND OVER TWO WEEKS OF SILENCE. Your own message told the other side you would entertain a reverse offer — a real position stated verbally with nothing on paper behind it. ⭐ The written feedback they have asked for five times IS your negotiating position; writing it is not a favour to them, it is putting your number on the record.

listings.status: 🔥 New cash deal — offer 8/5 morning, seller counter by 5:12 PM, your counter back by 7:18 PM the same day
listings.note: 🔥 AN OFFER-TO-COUNTER-TO-COUNTER ROUND TRIP INSIDE ONE DAY, still the fastest thing on this board by a wide margin. ✅ THE ACREAGE BLOCKER IS RETIRED: the seller's own two numbers imply roughly 157.6 acres — the first acreage ever stated on this tract — so the deal can finally be valued. ✅ Your buyer authorised the next number by text the same evening and your counter went back two hours later. ⚠️ There is a small conflict between two acreage figures now on file; it changes the math at the margins, not the deal.

listings.note: ✅ Both were created by the folder sync this morning and deliberately recorded as COMING SOON rather than ACTIVE, because neither is actually on the market — the engine never demotes a status, so stamping them ACTIVE early would have been permanent. ⭐ They are now visible to every routine instead of invisible, which is the point.

listings.note: ✅ THEY APPEAR HERE ON PURPOSE RATHER THAN BEING DROPPED — a listing that vanishes because nothing happened is how a seller goes ninety days without a call. 🔥 THE WILLOW POINT SELLERS ASKED FOR A LISTING APPOINTMENT AND NAMED THREE OPEN WINDOWS THEMSELVES — list one, buy another, and the ball has been in your court for ten days. Send a time, not a question. ✅ 361 White Oak finally got marketing after twenty-six dark days.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED AND PAID — the payout is receipted, and the feedback you owe the other agent is now openly overdue
listings.note: 🎉 ✅ PAID TODAY. This file had been carried as closed-but-unreceipted; the payday receipt came in this morning and the money is real. That retires it from the stranded-AR column entirely. ⚠️ WHAT DOES NOT RETIRE: the listing side asked for feedback three times and never got it. ⭐ The closing changed what that silence means — before it read as an oversight, now it reads as a shrug at the agent across the table on a deal you both just completed and both just got paid on.

listings.note: ⚠️ A closing with no receipted commission nine days later is the shape of a problem, not a delay — especially in a week where the business account has been the constraint every single day. ⭐ 683 Flag just proved these do land: that one was carried in this same column and paid this morning.

Chase the payout itself now.

pipeline.note: ✅ THE COUNT IS SETTLED AND SHOULD NOT BE RE-LITIGATED — Monday's Weekly Pipeline & Forecast led with 'THE COUNT IS SETTLED: GENE = 21. ACCOUNT-WIDE = 35,' the item three consecutive weekly reviews called the fleet's worst bug. ⭐ 21 at day 218 is about 5.5 behind an on-pace 26.5 and annualises to 36. ⏰ THE REAL DEADLINE IS NOT DECEMBER 31 — at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything counting for 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31, which is 12 weeks out. 🔥 AND TODAY PRODUCED THE FIRST REAL CANDIDATE IN A WEEK: the Fieldstone offer, written to close 10/13 as submitted and 10/30 in your counter. Either date counts for 2026 — but only if it goes under contract, and only your sellers can do that. ⭐ A past client also replied to a reconnect email in 82 minutes this morning wanting to buy on Lay or Logan Martin; that is the first inbound of its kind that lane has ever produced. ⚠️ The older shots still have not moved — a seller who named three open windows herself, a Lot-Land agreement signed Monday whose parcel still has no name, and a land buyer hunting for two and a half years. ⏰ AND THE LEAK IS STILL OPEN: two listings sit inside their agreement-expiry window, one of them eight days out with a live offer on it.

money.note: ✅ THE FIRST CLEAN DAY IN SEVEN HELD ALL THE WAY THROUGH — nothing bounced, nothing was returned, no fee was charged on either side, and yesterday's transfer cleared ahead of the day's withdrawals. That is real and it was earned in about ten minutes. ✅ AND ONE STRANDED PAYOUT ACTUALLY LANDED: the 683 Flag commission is receipted and paid, the first of the stalled closings to clear. ⚠️ TWO THINGS KEEP THIS ON ALERT ANYWAY. First, the accounting system's connection to the bank EXPIRED overnight, so every cash figure the books report is now unusable and materially overstated — the only trustworthy number is the one stamped by the bank itself. Second, two large recurring bills the calendar said would draft yesterday DID NOT DRAFT, which sounds like relief and is not: the calendar was wrong, the money is still owed, and nobody currently knows the real dates. ⚠️ Both were reclassified honestly this morning rather than left to look like a surplus. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS STILL NOT THE PROBLEM: August models above the survive line. September is the hole and it is still at zero — which is exactly why the Fieldstone counter matters tonight.

isa.decayPolicy: ⚠️ 55 OPEN, 22 OF THEM p1 — UP FOUR SINCE MIDDAY, AND EVERY ADDITION CAME OFF A LIVE SIGNAL RATHER THAN A BACKLOG. ⭐ THE LIST IS WORKING AS DESIGNED, NOT ROTTING: a large block are contactless address-only seller records queued for re-check — records that arrived with no name, no phone and no email, correctly held at zero touch rather than guessed at — and the rest came straight out of texts, voicemails and replies you were in the middle of. 🔥 THE p1 BLOCK IS WHERE THE MONEY IS: four named buyers off a single listing ad, one co-op agent holding a live buyer who wants to write, a past client who replied to a reconnect email in 82 minutes, two separate land questions, and one seller you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on whose consult never happened. 🔴 THE NUMBER THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU IS NOT 55 — IT IS THAT THE OLDEST p1 HAS ZERO TOUCHES OF ANY KIND, FOUR DAYS IN, and he came off the exact ad that just produced an offer. ⚠️ Six inbound leads still cannot be texted at all: they typed a number into your own form that carries a DNC marker, and no rule exists yet for what to do with them.
isa.sweepCadence: Every ~30 minutes through the send window, plus the instant responder on inbound. 🛑 THE RECONNECT LANE IS HELD AT THE EXECUTOR AND WILL NOT SEND AGAIN UNTIL YOU RULE. At 2:29 this afternoon you said the AI was 'running wild sending things I didn't ask it to do' about a note that went to a client, and the lane demoted itself on the spot from auto-send to draft-first. ⭐ That is the guard behaving exactly as designed — a single disavowed send costs the lane a rung immediately, no argument. A p1 is waiting on your ruling and nothing further goes out under it until you give one. ⭐ WHAT THE LANE DID BEFORE IT STOPPED IS WORTH KNOWING: five sent this morning, zero bounces, ten deliberately HELD because the machine found their anniversary and ownership premises were false — and one reply inside 82 minutes from a past client who wants to buy. ✅ THE LEAD LANE HAS READ DRY ON EVERY PASS TODAY, verified two independent ways each time; that is a confirmed quiet lane, not a broken one. ⚠️ A REAL DEFECT IS BANKED AND UNFIXED: the label-based lead query has now returned a FALSE EMPTY four separate times while the sender query found live threads — every routine that trusts the label alone is reading a lie.
